config.purpose: 4P4M8C common deterministic mafia exile target, disjoint coordinate fit/validation folds, and unconditional coverage-benefit selection for public civilian probes

table_crossfit.selection: Each coordinate-pass pair has unique fit and validation seed blocks. Fit proposes a grid response; validation accepts only if worst-opponent rate improves by at least 0.5pp and mean is noninferior within 0.5pp.

probe_selection.selection: Choose the civilian probe with highest unconditional worst-opponent complete-game win rate on fit openings. Accept over silent only if independent validation improves worst rate by at least 0.25pp and does not lower mean rate.

config.interpretation: All experiments use 4P4M8C and public sequential ballots. Deterministic mafia vote ties use shared score, public speech order and seat. Every table coordinate-pass has distinct fit and validation seeds, and final matrix seeds are untouched. Civilian probes are selected and reported by unconditional outcomes across every hit opening; activation and alignment only decompose coverage. Results are finite-policy strategy evaluation, not full-game GTO or CFR convergence.

intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95%; no multiplicity correction. Paired Wald plus conservative Hoeffding.
outcome: good faction terminal win, 0/1; no rollout truncation
